title: When Does Task-Aware Imputation Matter? An Analysis of Robustness Under Train-Test Mismatch
abstract: arXiv:2610.20342v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Missing data is a pervasive challenge in machine learning, often degrading predictive performance and complicating model deployment. Most existing approaches treat imputation as a preprocessing step independent of the downstream task, a separation that becomes problematic under train-test mismatches in missingness mechanisms or rates. We introduce a unified framework that treats missing entries as variables in a task-conditioned optimization problem. We instantiate this framework in two settings: an amortized approach for scenarios with missing data at both training and test time, and a latent optimization approach for settings where only training data is incomplete. translated_title: 任务感知插补何时重要？训练-测试不匹配下的鲁棒性分析
translated_abstract: 缺失数据是机器学习中普遍存在的挑战，常常降低预测性能并使模型部署复杂化。大多数现有方法将插补视为独立于下游任务的预处理步骤，当训练与测试数据在缺失机制或缺失率上不匹配时，这种分离会带来问题。我们引入了一个统一框架，将缺失条目视为任务条件优化问题中的变量。我们在两种设置下实例化该框架：一种摊销方法适用于训练和测试时均存在缺失数据的场景，另一种潜在优化方法适用于仅训练数据不完整的设置。评估在98个表格数据集上进行，并在36个数据集上评估了训练-测试不匹配下的鲁棒性。结果表明，重构误差并不能很好地代理预测效用（Spearman rho 约为 0.16 到 0.32），而任务感知……
tldr: 该论文提出将缺失数据插补与下游任务统一建模的框架，并在98个表格数据集上证明重构误差无法有效代表预测效用，任务感知的插补方法在训练-测试缺失机制不匹配时更具鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified task-conditioned framework treating missing entries as optimization variables, showing across 98 tabular datasets that reconstruction error poorly proxies predictive utility and that task-aware imputation enhances robustness under train-test mismatches in missingness mechanisms or rates.
